items.title: Targets and bands editor, inline "Set target", band colouring from metric_targets

items.title: Multi-office comparison dashboard: ranking, office scorecard with group subtotals, same-store, dispersion

items.title: Alerts: condition schema, evaluator, metric_alert_states, notifications, "Alert me", acknowledge and snooze

items.title: Followed-metrics digest and shipped alert templates

items.title: Outreach results view: attempts, outcomes, value scheduled and collected per worklist, user and channel

items.title: Customisation v2 (free grid, tile library with the off-by-default tiles), mobile rendering of the other dashboards

items.title: Snapshot-backed trends of state metrics; start-of-day and actual-versus-scheduled tiles

items.title: Advanced letter templates (legacy Advanced Custom Letter): block editor, embedded patient images, referral data tags, ledger date-range prompt

items.title: Actual versus scheduled production (analytics.production_vs_schedule) and the appointment-grain start-of-day snapshot request
items.depends_on_text: DATA-48, NEW rpt_scheduled_production_snapshot_lines (requested of 03 as a DATA-48 acceptance criterion), DATA-16, DATA-17 (moved out)
items.acceptance: For a fixture day with 5 booked, 1 cancelled, 1 added and 1 walk-in appointment, the bridge closes to the produced amount; without the appointment-grain table the lost, added and kept columns render not_available and the office x provider bridge still closes; a day before the snapshot go-live renders history starts on <date>

items.title: Cash-conversion waterfall (analytics.cash_conversion_waterfall) with the overlap rule and stage detail lists
items.depends_on_text: DATA-30, RPT-NEW-14, RPT-NEW-16, cash_conversion_waterfall_amount and the overlap rule in 05 §5.13 (challenge)
items.acceptance: Stages 1, 2 and 4 equal the metric for their waterfall_stage; a fixture patient portion not collected at the visit and still open 120 days later counts once, in stage 3, and is netted from stage 5; estimated cash = gross minus the four stages; each stage's detail rows sum to the stage

items.title: analytics.patient_value definition: annual and lifetime value per patient and account, top accounts
items.depends_on_text: DATA-48, DATA-26 (allocated reading), 05 NEW value keys
items.acceptance: patient_value_annual equals the metric; patient-level lifetime production equals rpt_patient_activity.lifetime_charged_production on the charged basis; account totals equal the sum of current members; the k14 caveat prints for migrated periods

items.title: analytics.provider_scorecard definition: matrix and review sheet over the metric registry, peers and suppression
items.depends_on_text: ENG-51, ENG-50, DASH-38, DATA-24, DATA-30, 02 python_builder whitelist entry
items.acceptance: Every cell equals the provider-dashboard metric for the same parameters; a restricted caller receives only the own row and no office value below 5 other providers; a degraded cell has no band and no rank; the review-sheet PDF breaks per provider

items.title: analytics.revenue_opportunity definition: six categories, what-if rates, kind subtotals, per-category rights
items.depends_on_text: the six worklists (06 §6), DATA-26, DATA-27, DATA-30, 05 NEW recall_opportunity_amount / claims_unsent_amount / revenue_opportunity_default_rates, 02 right_codes_any[]
items.acceptance: Each category value equals its metric for the same scope and date; a caller without the insurance family sees the two insurance rows as restricted; no total adds production and cash; each row drills to its worklist (or print counterpart before it ships)

items.title: Office comparison and same-store growth (analytics.office_comparison): three formats, metric packs, comparator rows, rank movement, same-store set with exclusions
items.depends_on_text: ENG-50, ENG-51, MET-23, MET-21, DATA-47, NEW pack registry (06), NEW parameters (04), office groups setup (06 §5.2)
items.acceptance: Group and organisation rows equal the metric service for the same scope (never summed ratios); a newly opened office is excluded as opened_too_recently and named; weighted, simple and trimmed growth equal hand-computed fixture values; an office below rate_min_denominator is unranked; no shipped pack contains rcm_health_score; a caller with two assigned offices gets comparators over those two only

items.title: Outreach results (analytics.outreach_results) over the follow-up tables
items.depends_on_text: DASH-29, DASH-43, MET-19, NEW outreach metrics (05)
items.acceptance: For a fixture campaign the realised value equals the fees booked inside the attribution window; completion equals follow_up_completion_pct; a team member sees only the own row; a worklist of a family the caller lacks is one restricted row

items.title: Cross-office patient flow (analytics.cross_office_patient_flow): summary, pairs, referrals, detail
items.depends_on_text: DATA-47, DATA-39, 05 cross_office_patients, NEW cross_office_production_share_pct / internal_referral_completed_pct (05 §5.13), NEW parameters (04)
items.acceptance: cross_office_patients equals the 05 metric; own + visiting patients of an office equal its patients_seen; a fixture patient seen at two offices appears once in the organisation total; an internal referral charged at the sister office within the window is completed

items.title: Schema request for legacy holiday fidelity: provider_holidays.end_date, recurrence_rule, open_start_time, open_end_time, lunch_start, lunch_end (NEW, to 03 as an extension of DATA-45) and the open_hours / recurrence columns that read them

items.title: Referral Production List P4: compare_to prior-period columns and the all-office activity option (key aligned with r05 / r06)
items.acceptance: Prior-period columns equal a separate run for the prior range; the all-office option changes only the money legs, never the patient population

items.title: Case worklists and row actions (book, register prospect, log contact, send referral report, SMS, task) on live paging for Internal and External Incoming
items.acceptance: Actions resolve ids from the snapshot; SMS exclusions are counted; a logged contact removes the case from "To call today" on the next page load

items.title: Prior-period comparison and new-patient cohort on Referral Summary and Referral Count Summary (compare_to, first_visit_date_)
items.acceptance: compare_to = none leaves the legacy columns unchanged; previous-year production of a source equals a separate run over the previous year

items.title: Treatment Plan Analysis enhancements: funnel format, organisation total block, code filter, comparison period
items.acceptance: funnel four stage amounts reconcile with treatment_funnel_amount with include_inactive_patients = true (the outside row excluded, internal_referral items inside the stages); the standard default run is unchanged; comparison columns use the same cohort rule for the prior period

items.title: Privacy rules for scorecards and office comparison
items.acceptance: Ranking and percentile tiles follow PR-8 and SC-1; a restricted provider sees their own value, a peer mean from 5 other providers and a distribution from 10, and suppressed below

items.title: Per-recipient schedules and alert conditions
items.acceptance: One run per distinct scope_hash; a condition is evaluated on the recipient's scope and reveals nothing outside it; the owner's run history shows delivery status only for runs made with another recipient's scope

items.title: Dashboard frame v2 for DASH-44: grid library spike, free grid placement with a keyboard alternative, present-mode shell, phone layout of the frame
items.acceptance: A customised layout is restored on another device; every move possible by drag is possible by keyboard; present mode hides the application chrome

items.title: Alerts and digests in the Schedules page (kind filter, firings, acknowledge, snooze, mute); alert and assignment notifications in the tray; metric settings and code-group administration tab
items.depends_on_text: UX-33, UX-34, ENG-52, DASH-41, MET-02, MET-03

items.title: Assistant service: contract of 8.6, plan validation, tool loop, verification, quotas, audit, provider interface
items.acceptance: Only schema-valid MetricQueryRequests execute; a question outside the registry returns out_of_scope; a user never receives a value they cannot see in a dashboard; every call is audited

items.title: Explain-this-number facts: components, change, contributor decomposition, related metrics
items.acceptance: Contributor deltas sum to the total change including other; rate and mix effects sum to the ratio's change on the fixture

items.title: Narrative summaries and anomaly detection with the insight strip
items.acceptance: Every number in a generated text exists in the facts payload, otherwise the template is used; a seeded outlier is detected and a low-volume office is skipped

items.title: Ask bar, answer card, interpretation chips, sentence-to-filters, feedback
items.acceptance: Editing a chip re-runs the query without a model call; sentence-to-filters never runs a report by itself

items.title: Assistant evaluation set and regression run
items.acceptance: The suite runs on every registry, prompt or model change and reports plan accuracy per question group

items.title: Builder content from the user's side: dataset labels and field descriptions, template gallery, folder tags, custom scorecard tiles
items.acceptance: Every dataset of 9.2 is offered with described fields; a template opens as an editable draft; a custom report appears under custom with its folder tag

items.title: Custom-definition store, validation, compilation
items.acceptance: A published spec runs through the standard pipeline with snapshots and exports

items.title: Builder limits, EXPLAIN cost gate, preview as a run
items.acceptance: A query over the threshold is routed to background or refused; a preview has an audit event and a manifest

items.title: Assistant tool endpoints over the metric registry
items.acceptance: The assistant can execute only MetricQueryRequest objects within the caller's scope

items.title: Custom KPI definitions (organisation formulas over base measures and metrics)
items.acceptance: A custom ratio validates, is versioned per organisation and obeys the data classes of its components

items.title: Assistant grounding: aliases, example questions and dimension phrases per metric (PD-14)
items.acceptance: The assistant resolves each alias to its key and cites the definition and settings versions it used

items.title: Office Reports of the organisation: every captured report mapped to a standard report, an alias or a seeded custom report
items.acceptance: Every report of the captured Office Reports tree runs in the hub under its legacy name or carries a signed "not needed"; seeded custom reports pass the builder validation

items.title: Builder guardrails and definition change audit
items.acceptance: An author cannot save a spec on a dataset none of whose report families they hold, nor one that references a field of a class they lack; a runner who holds custom and a share but no report family of the dataset gets 403; a fixed filter, group key or sort on a field of a class the runner lacks is 403 data_class_denied, a displayed non-key column of that class is dropped; visibility = organization needs reports_share_organization; publish and archive emit report.definition.

items.title: Assistant controls (§9)
items.acceptance: With the feature off the endpoint is 404; a question naming a fixture patient is refused; a captured vendor payload holds only aggregates that passed SC-1 and SC-2 and no member label outside the dimensions declared allow or alias (a patient-named referral source appears as its source type; providers and users as aliases); question, tool calls and answer each have an event

items.title: Report builder screens: pickers, List / Summary, preview, spec errors by path, publish, share, Customise from a standard report (content of datasets, template gallery and folder tags: DASH-51)
items.acceptance: A published custom report runs in the normal runner with exports, views and schedules; an invalid spec cannot be published

items.title: Assistant slots in the module chrome (hub, dashboard header, runner header), hand-over of fill_parameters into the form, hiding when the assistant is off
items.acceptance: A sentence fills the runner form and nothing runs until Run is pressed; with the organisation switch off no assistant entry point is rendered
